title: stenandriopsis decaryi
intro: Stenandriopsis decaryi, commonly known as Madagascar periwinkle, is a plant species native to Madagascar. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to stimulate the immune system and lower blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of the plant include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce stress, improve wound healing, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids like vincristine and vinblastine, which have been isolated and used in cancer treatments.
